name: 进门-观点梳理
description_zh: 依赖进门 MCP 检索多类机构研究资料，总结、对比不同机构对目标研究对象的近期观点，并输出机构观点汇总表与共识分歧分析。适用于用户给出研究对象（股票、行业、事件、宏观指标等），要求汇总券商/外资投行观点、对比机构分歧、梳理市场共识时。
description_en: Requires the Comein MCP to retrieve multiple types of institutional research materials, then summarizes and compares recent views from different institutions on a target research subject, producing an institutional view table and an analysis of consensus and disagreements. Use it when the user provides a subject, such as a stock, industry, event, or macroeconomic indicator, and asks to summarize broker or foreign investment bank views, compare institutional disagreements, or identify market consensus.
